name: Tile Kingdoms
description: A tile-laying worker-placement strategy game on the invented realm of Kare Kralliklar (Tile Kingdoms): draw tiles from a 72-tile bag, match their four edges (keep walls, trade roads, meadows, sacred marches) and place Watchmen, Guards, Monks and Farmers to score completed roads, cities and shrines. Original theme, original tile names, original texts and fully code-generated artwork; only the tile-placement mechanics are shared with the genre.
author: Chambler Pack Team

en.worker.scout.name: Watchman
en.worker.scout.use: Stands on a road; reaps 1 point per tile when that road closes.
en.worker.guard.name: Guard
en.worker.guard.use: Stands in a city; takes 2 points per tile plus pennant bonuses when it closes.
en.worker.monk.name: Monk
en.worker.monk.use: Stands at a shrine; claims 9 points once all eight neighbours land.
en.worker.farmer.name: Farmer
en.worker.farmer.use: Stays in the field; his harvest is only counted at the end.

en.color.sand.name: Sand

en.token.worker-lagoon.name: Lagoon Worker
en.token.worker-moss.name: Moss Worker
en.token.worker-plum.name: Plum Worker
en.token.worker-sand.name: Sand Worker
en.rule.turn: On your turn: draw a tile, lay it, optionally place one worker, score what you closed.
en.rule.draw: Draw one tile from the bag and keep its face to yourself.
en.rule.place: The new tile must touch the map along at least one edge; never leave a gap.
en.rule.edge-match: Facing edges must carry the same kind: city to city, road to road, shrine to shrine, field to field.
en.rule.fallback: If the tile fits nowhere, return it to the bag and pass without a worker.
en.rule.worker: Place a worker on the new tile's feature: Watchman on road, Guard in city, Monk at shrine, Farmer in field.
en.rule.majority: The player with the most workers on a closed feature scores it; ties share the score.
en.rule.road-score: A completed road scores 1 point per tile.
en.rule.city-score: A completed city scores 2 points per tile; each pennant +2, the Great Keep +2.
en.rule.shrine-score: A shrine ringed by its eight neighbours scores 9 points in total.
en.rule.field-score: Fields score only at the end: each farmer earns 3 points per completed city it touches.
en.rule.end: When the bag runs dry the last round is played; unfinished work scores short.
en.rule.first-tile: The Throne City opens the game, face up, dead centre of the table.
